Metadata.title: Weihang Li — Full-Stack Developer
Metadata.description: Full-stack developer building complete web products, from interface to backend to deployment. Open to freelance projects and full-time roles.

Hero.tagline: A full-stack developer who can design, build, deploy and maintain a product — entirely on my own.

WhatIDo.heading: WHAT I DO /
WhatIDo.label: (Expertise)
WhatIDo.intro: As a full-stack developer, I know the whole chain — front end, back end, and the maintenance that follows. Taking a product from idea to launch is the easy part; ideas and creativity are what really count.

services.title: Full-Stack Development
services.description: I've worked with most of today's mainstream frameworks and databases. They all have one thing in common: each is just a different way to solve a business problem.

services.title: Interactive Interfaces
services.description: Dashboards, maps, real-time 3D and motion — the parts that look complicated and hard to get right are exactly where I'm most at home.

services.title: Ship & Automate
services.description: Writing the code is only part of the job. I know containerised deployment and operations well — including every pitfall along the way. And in the age of AI, I believe developers who don't use it get left behind.

Works.heading: SELECTED WORKS /
Works.label: (Projects)
Works.intro: Here are a few projects I designed and built on my own — some open source, some commercial platforms.

hynelWeb.title: Hynel Energy
hynelWeb.summary: Official bilingual website for Hynel Energy's solar and storage business. Built solo with choreographed scroll motion, an interactive co-investment calculator, and a live platform preview.

portfolio.title: My Portfolio
portfolio.summary: The site you're looking at. Designed and built from scratch in five languages, with smooth scrolling, choreographed motion, and a contact form that reaches me directly.

keyboardDesigner.title: Keyboard Designer
keyboardDesigner.summary: A browser-based keycap designer. Pick a layout, set colours, place artwork and check it in real-time 3D, then export PNG, SVG, JSON or production-ready jig files. No sign-up needed — all you need is a browser.

hynel.title: Hynel HEEPS
hynel.summary: An earlier electricity-market analytics and price-forecasting SaaS covering Guangdong and Europe. Built solo: the time-series and map dashboards, the CMS, role-based access control and the Alipay subscription flow.

vehicleSearch.title: Vehicle Search Script
vehicleSearch.summary: A desktop tool for vehicle-recovery teams. Import plates in bulk, check parking records in parallel, and get a Telegram alert the moment there's a match — with live progress, a data dashboard and one-click packaged builds.

About.lead: I'm Weihang, a full-stack developer based in China. I love going from zero to one — every new product still gets me excited.
About.p1: Most of my work is in TypeScript — React and Vue on the front end, Node.js and NestJS on the back — with Java (Spring Boot) and Python when a project calls for it. Beyond the web, I've shipped Electron desktop apps and built mobile apps with React Native and Flutter.
About.p2: I care about the details people feel but rarely put into words: whether an interface looks good and works well, whether motion feels smooth, whether an error message is short and clear.
